reason: The free first visit gets me in the door with zero risk, and the 5-pack at $60 is the only thing that feels workable on my budget. I'd try it once free, maybe use a pack if the baby area really is separate.
objection: Will bigger kids be running wild around my baby? The gated Baby Nook helps, but $13 a visit adds up fast on $42k and I'd rather wait for a Groupon.
would_change_my_mind: A Groupon or intro deal, plus seeing the Baby Nook in real life and confirming the capped headcount keeps bigger kids away from my baby.
